title: Administrative Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
As an Administrative Business Partner, you're at the heart of your team's business operations and activities and the soul that keeps your team moving forward. You anticipate the needs of your managers and team members and help them stay focused on their projects by resolving operational and administrative issues before they arise. You move quickly with the changing environment and are up to date with the latest Google products and services. You also use that knowledge to strategically support your team's projects. In addition to being organized and analytical, you possess the strong business judgment and communication skills needed to interact with a variety of people and job functions. Administrative jobs at Google are staffed by organized and dependable people driven by a common company goal: to help us accomplish great things. Working behind the scenes, we make a significant impact on the people we support as well as on Google users around the world. We're adept at leading and managing a variety of simultaneous projects, which requires the particular talent of being able to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the executive calendar and daily schedule by prioritizing time against business goals, Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), and critical leadership moments while coordinating across multiple executive offices, Google Leads, and external VIPs.
  • Oversee complex, high-frequency domestic and international travel itineraries, accommodations, and ground logistics while preparing detailed travel briefings and proactively resolving multi-time zone scheduling conflicts.
  • Maintain absolute confidentiality and discretion on sensitive business, organizational, and personnel matters.
  • Lead end-to-end operational planning for critical moments, executive offsites, meetings, and leadership forums while providing high-touch support for internal and external engagements.
  • Build efficiencies into executive workflows by defining best practices.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of administrative experience in a technology or international environment working on core administrative tasks (e.g., travel management, expense reports, calendar management, facilities coordination, etc.)
  • Experience in executive support, administrative operations management, non-technical project management, or corporate event planning.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 3 years of administrative experience in a technology or international environment working on core administrative tasks (e.g., travel management, expense reports, calendar management, facilities coordination, etc.).
  • 3 years of administrative experience supporting executive-level management in a corporate environment, and managing small-scale projects and events from pre-planning to execution.
  • Experience in Google Workspace applications, including Documents, Slides, Sheets, and Forms.
  • Ability to communicate in Mandarin and English fluently to support clients in this region.

title: Senior Staff AI/ML Engineer, Cloud AI Research
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The frontier of AI is moving faster than the traditional enterprise deployment lifecycle can tolerate. Our organization exists to eliminate that "GenAI Engineering Gap." Operating as an AI-Native pathfinding engine at the intersection of foundational research, optimized ML infrastructure and rapid prototyping, we don't simply publish papers; we build the future of AI agents and deploy them at breakneck speed.

In this role, you will guide executive leadership, deconstruct the enterprise bottlenecks across Google Cloud, and architect the overarching blueprints for our agent state machines. You will direct the technical agenda for generalizable horizontal agents and vertical Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) deployments, ensuring that our pathfinding velocity unlocks massive commercial and platform value while simultaneously pushing the boundaries of AI science.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Architect the technical framework for high-velocity "Strike Sprints," defining the gold standard for intent-driven AI topologies, reflection loops, and advanced agent state machines across the entire organization.
  • Serve as the principal technical anchor for massive Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) missions, aligning directly with VP/Director-level partners to translate speculative agentic prototypes into enterprise solutions.
  • Set the architectural goals and lead the development of generalizable horizontal agents (e.g., AutoResearch and AutoFounder) that fundamentally alter engineering velocity across Google.
  • Direct the research agenda to develop agent architectures, novel planning frameworks, and self-improving foundation models.
  • Act as a thought leader across Google, defining centrally governed agentic playbooks, and actively publishing definitive breakthroughs at ML conferences.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development, including experience with Python, C++, Java, or JavaScript.
  • 8 years of experience leading large-scale ML system design and optimizing ML infrastructure (e.g., distributed training, model deployment, evaluation).
  • Experience developing autonomous agents, multi-agent workflows, or agentic frameworks (e.g., AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph, ADK, tool-use/function-calling, or multi-agent).
  • Experience designing, pre-training, fine-tuning, or evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and multimodal foundation models.

Preferred qualifications:

  • PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.
  • Extensive track record of first-author scientific publication submissions on agents in machine learning and NLP at venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL).
  • Demonstrated success operating as a Senior Staff/Principal technical lead orchestrating rapid SWAT, Pathfinding, or Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) environments at an enterprise level.
  • Industry-leading expertise in RL, reward modeling, and human/AI preference alignment techniques.
  • Deep mastery in developing test-time scaling methods, search-guided decoding, adversarial robustness, and complex alignment guardrails.

title: Technical Account Manager, Google Cloud Consulting (Mandarin, English)
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the adoption of Google Cloud at organizations, guiding them through the technical facets of their Google Cloud transformation journey. You will manage the delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive customer adoption of Google Cloud services. In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including leadership of enterprises and a cross-functional and geographically dispersed team.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Accelerate customer adoption of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey, providing technical guidance and managing timelines, milestones, migration goals and business transformation strategies.
  • Advocate for customer needs to overcome adoption blockers and drive new feature development, leading across multiple work streams and teams to maintain customer momentum.
  • Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand a customer’s business and develop roadmaps, leading quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to understand business and technical needs.
  • Plan for customer events and launches, partnering with support, engineering, and site reliability engineering to ensure customer success during critical moments, working with customers and support to guide issues/escalations to resolution.
  • Develop best practices and assets based on learnings from customer engagements to support initiatives to scale through partners and accelerate cloud adoption.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in a customer-facing role working with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
  • Experience supporting enterprise customers in Cloud Professional Services organizations, IT consulting, or program management organizations.
  • Ability to communicate in Mandarin and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
  • Experience in application/workload migration to public cloud providers, and with collaborating across business units internally and at enterprises.
  • Experience collaborating with channel partners, systems integrators, and Third-Party developers to deliver solutions.
  • Understanding of any one of the following IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.

title: Head of Application Development Practice, Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are engineered for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will guide enterprise organizations as they refactor monolithic workloads, embrace microservices, and transition to cloud-native paradigms. You will lead strategic initiatives to design, operate, and scale critical software systems while establishing best practices in application lifecycle management, API design, and automated continuous delivery across Google Cloud infrastructure.

Google Cloud accelerates organizations’ ability to digitally transform their business with the best infrastructure, platform, industry solutions and expertise. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology – all on the cleanest cloud in the industry. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the APAC professional services application modernisation practice through strategy and execution, driving legacy workload transformation across JAPAC and other regions. Drive regional practice strategy, presales agreement qualification, and operational metrics (utilization, revenue, capacity forecasting).
  • Guide enterprise customers through application refactoring, transitioning monolithic architectures to microservices, APIs, and serverless models. Architect cloud-native application architectures, enabling scalability, resilience, and continuous delivery across Google Cloud infrastructure.
  • Advise technical leaders and Engineering teams on Containerisation strategies, Kubernetes deployment, AI agent architecture, and adopting cloud-native application patterns.
  • Establish best practices and frameworks for modernising legacy workloads, API management, DevOps integration, and cloud-native application lifecycle management.
  • Manage, mentor, and scale a high-performing, cross-regional team of technical consultants across JAPAC.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience leading application modernization, refactoring legacy workloads, and architecting cloud-native solutions.
  • 3 years of experience in people management and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Experience designing microservices architectures, containerized deployments (e.g., Kubernetes), serverless models, and API-driven application frameworks.
  • Experience designing and architecting agentic AI systems and workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience refactoring complex monolithic systems into decoupled microservices, APIs, and event-driven architectures on Google Cloud.
  • Experience implementing modern CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and application lifecycle automation for continuous delivery.
  • Experience with modern cloud-native observability, service mesh, API gateway management, and cloud security patterns.
  • Ability to drive end-to-end cloud-native transformations for enterprise clients, from legacy workload assessment to implementation.
  • Ability to advise C-level and technical leadership on strategic technology roadmaps and cloud-native transformation governance.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional collaboration and drive strategic alignment across specialized practices, such as Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

From the rapid rise of foundational AI to critical debates over digital sovereignty, safety, and economic competitiveness, the policy decisions made today will shape the next generation of human progress.

Google’s Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team is seeking an exceptional political strategist and executor to manage global campaigns.
In this role, you will build and drive the campaigns that support Google’s long-term policy priorities translating complex technical issues into compelling narratives, creative formats, and targeted initiatives that empower our teams across the world and move key audiences. You will understand what influences decision-makers and the cultural and media currents around them, and you will bring the operational creative goal to match the right tactics to the right moments.

To succeed, you will bring sharp political and corporate acumen, with proven experience operating within complex, fast-moving, matrixed environments.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $181000 - $247000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design campaigns that translate corporate policy priorities into measurable objectives, clear messaging, stakeholder maps, and actionable roadmaps.
  • Drive end-to-end execution of global campaigns alongside internal teams and agency partners.
  • Establish clear workstreams, milestones, budgets, and reporting frameworks to assess performance and iterate over time.
  • Develop persuasive, research-based narratives and content, ensuring messages reach key stakeholders via the most effective messengers, channels, and moments.
  • Enable partners internal and external to communicate effectively and consistently by developing and distributing toolkits, cross-format content, and message assets that help narratives break through in a crowded environment.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in public affairs, issue advocacy, corporate advocacy, political campaigns, or communications.
  • Experience leading multi-market advocacy, marketing, or public awareness campaigns.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience designing scalable advocacy strategies and adapting campaign executions across regions, balancing global message discipline with local political and cultural context.
  • Experience across modern campaign levers, including opinion research, paid and earned media, and impact analytics.
  • Ability to convert dense technical, economic, or regulatory topics into compelling narratives, deploying non-traditional advocacy formats, digital assets, and creative partnerships that cut through noise.
  • Ability to build consensus across matrixed cross-functional teams and mobilize external partners, including industry associations, think tanks, and civil society leaders.
  • Demonstrated success running high-stakes political or issue campaigns, preferably in technology or regulatory policy.

title: Quality Program Manager, YouTube Trust and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Fast-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust and Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust and Safety team is enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in the ever-evolving digital world.

This role will help steer the quality assurance program to ensure quality in vendor operations. You’ll set the standards for operational quality and processes, ensure all vendor sites meet and exceed those goals. Partnering with Operations experts, you’ll continuously fine tune the operational framework to improve user experience and quality of the results. This role may be exposed to graphic, controversial, and sometimes offensive video content during team escalations in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Ireland: €86000 - €88000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Build/Support a global quality program, driving consistency and continuous improvement across workflows/processes.
  • Support, design, and deploy quality programs for data labeling for AI/ML.
  • Improve Key Performance Indicators by evolving the Quality Assurance system to better identify, measure, and improve opportunities in processes, tools, and training.
  • Work alongside YouTube’s Product, Enforcement, and Partner teams to prepare for product launches and keep pace with product and policy changes.
  • May be exposed to graphic, controversial, and sometimes offensive video content during team escalations in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in a customer or client-facing role supporting Trust and Safety vendor operations.
  • 5 years of experience building relationships with stakeholders or clients.
  • 5 years of experience improving and identifying issues in processes and creating solutions, and working with cross-functional teams to drive these changes.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in data labeling quality assurance and evaluation frameworks for multimodal AI/ML models.
  • Experience in data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Looker Studio, Tableau) to synthesize complex datasets into insights.
  • Experience in large-scale program and project management, aligning operational execution with business strategy and stakeholder governance.
  • Knowledge of quality management methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, TQM, COPC) to optimize operational performance.
  • Excellent partner and vendor operations management skills, with the ability to drive collaborative cross-functional relationships.

title: Applied Solutions Architect, Data and AI
descriptionHtml:
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

The Google Forge Team partners with our most strategic customers to bring their transformative goals to life. In the agentic era, enterprise data architectures must evolve from passive Systems of Intelligence built for human-scale reporting into active, governed "Systems of Action" engineered for agent-scale autonomy.

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end architectural design and engineering of next-generation agentic data platforms—unifying operational and analytical data estates, open multimodal lakehouses, semantic knowledge catalogs, and graph reasoning to ground and scale autonomous AI agents. You will play a key leadership role in driving solutions from initial architecture through enterprise security, governance, and production readiness, while mentoring team members and shaping the strategic direction of our reusable engineering assets.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and iterative refinement of data-centric and AI-powered solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), showcasing the potential of data and AI to address specific business needs.
  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand their business challenges, technical requirements, and strategic objectives.
  • Mentor and guide team members, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
  • Establish and promote innovative best practices and methodologies for data-motivated solutions, actively contributing to industry thought leadership through publications, presentations, and community engagement.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
  • Experience with Big Data technologies or concepts, such as analytics warehousing, data processing, data transformation, data governance, data migrations, extract, transform, load (ETL), extract, load, transform (ELT), SQL, NoSQL, performance or scalability optimizations, or batch versus streaming.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 10 years of experience architecting and delivering large-scale distributed data platforms, cloud-native software, and AI-driven systems in a customer-facing engineering, principal architecture, or technical consulting role.
  • Experience designing property/knowledge graphs (GQL, Cypher, RDF/OWL), enterprise semantic catalogs, or multimodal data pipelines that process and index unstructured data alongside tabular data.
  • Real-world experience taking data and AI systems through enterprise InfoSec and governance sign-off into production, implementing automated LLM/agent evaluation harnesses, semantic caching, and compute/query optimization for high-concurrency workloads.
  • Proven track record of owning multi-stakeholder technical transformations, quantifying architectural trade-offs and building consensus with executives.

title: Quản lý chương trình vật liệu bền vững
descriptionHtml:
Một vấn đề chỉ thực sự được giải quyết khi không còn ai gặp vướng mắc. Đó là lý do nhân viên của Google xây dựng những sản phẩm tạo ra cơ hội cho mọi người, bất kể là họ sinh sống tại địa phương hay ở bên kia Địa Cầu. Trong vai trò Quản lý chương trình tại Google, bạn sẽ dẫn dắt từ đầu đến cuối các dự án phức tạp và đa lĩnh vực — làm việc với các bên liên quan để dự trù yêu cầu, quản lý lịch biểu dự án, phát hiện rủi ro và trao đổi rõ ràng với các đối tác liên chức năng trong công ty. Thường thì các dự án sẽ trải rộng qua nhiều văn phòng, múi giờ và bán cầu. Công việc của bạn là điều phối các bên liên quan và giúp họ luôn nắm được tiến độ và thời hạn.

Sứ mệnh của Google là hệ thống hoá thông tin của thế giới và làm cho thông tin đó trở nên hữu ích và dễ tiếp cận trên toàn cầu. Nhóm Thiết bị và dịch vụ của chúng tôi kết hợp những điểm ưu việt nhất có trong AI của Google, Phần mềm và Phần cứng, nhằm mang lại trải nghiệm hữu ích về mọi mặt cho người dùng. Chúng tôi nghiên cứu, thiết kế và phát triển các công nghệ cùng phần cứng mới để người dùng có thể tương tác với công nghệ điện toán một cách nhanh chóng, mạnh mẽ và liền mạch hơn. Dù là tìm kiếm những cách mới để nắm bắt và cảm nhận thế giới xung quanh, cải tiến các yếu tố hình thức hay cải thiện phương pháp tương tác, mục tiêu mà nhóm Thiết bị và dịch vụ của chúng tôi hướng đến là làm cho cuộc sống của mọi người trở nên tốt đẹp hơn thông qua công nghệ.

Responsibilities

  • Đảm bảo vật tư luôn sẵn sàng cho các đợt sản xuất hàng loạt một cách nhất quán.
  • Là đầu mối liên lạc chính về vật tư với các Nhà sản xuất thiết kế gốc (ODM) hoặc Nhà thầu sản xuất (CM) và các nhóm khác nhau trong Google để đưa sản phẩm vào sản xuất và ra mắt.
  • Xác định các rủi ro chuỗi cung ứng và các bước giảm thiểu để đảm bảo vật tư sẵn sàng khi sản phẩm đi vào sản xuất hàng loạt (giai đoạn duy trì) và cho đến khi Kết thúc vòng đời sản phẩm (EOL).
  • Cập nhật tình hình, đánh giá rủi ro và tác động để tạo nên những thay đổi tích cực. Thúc đẩy các sáng kiến và cải tiến quy trình để hỗ trợ nhóm. Đại diện bộ phận vật tư trong các cuộc họp chương trình nội bộ.
  • Duy trì hồ sơ ngân sách và cung cấp Dịch vụ khách hàng chất lượng cao cho khách hàng nội bộ. Quản lý, đánh giá hiệu suất nhà cung cấp/CM, đề xuất đối tác tiềm năng, hỗ trợ các chương trình giảm chi phí.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý chương trình hoặc dự án.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý vật tư và thu mua.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý dự án liên ngành hoặc liên phòng ban.
  • 3 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý Nhà sản xuất theo hợp đồng (CM).
  • 3 năm kinh nghiệm vận hành các ứng dụng phần mềm, bao gồm cả kinh nghiệm về Hoạch định tài nguyên doanh nghiệp.
  • Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc, chú trọng từng chi tiết nhỏ.

title: Software Engineer, Content Safety, Core
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Content Safety organization in Core provides safety solutions that protect Google’s users from exposure to offensive, sensitive or harmful content. The team unblock and accelerate Google's product launches by providing quality implementations of company-wide standards for Responsible Artificial Intelligence (AI). The team combines subject matter expertise in the content safety domain and a practice of machine learning and AI-based techniques with the production-grade experience in serving infrastructure and product integrations to protect users from harm, maintain Google’s engagement in the area of online safety across the industry, and make foundational models and the internet safer for society.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Write and maintain high-quality, readable, and well-tested code for on-device and server-side content safety applications.
  • Develop and test validation gates, routing logic, and tool-use schemas to ensure deterministic and compliant execution within our autonomous safety agent pipelines.
  • Contribute to implementing and maintaining both stateless and stateful agentic flows, supporting multi-step AI orchestration pipelines that interact with Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), databases, and external tools to automate safety decisions.
  • Support the team in delivering on commitments to clients, ensuring robust and performant solutions to user protection challenges.
  • Collaborate closely with mentors and executive engineers to learn Google’s development processes, design patterns, and system architectures.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
  • 1 year of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 1 year of experience implementing core Machine Learning (ML) concepts.
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or Large Language Model (LLM) interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Academic, internship, or personal project experience integrating generative AI APIs and foundation model endpoints into software applications.
  • Familiarity with building agentic workflows, including chaining model prompts, configuring model tool-use (e.g., function calling), and integrating foundation models with external APIs or databases.
  • Basic familiarity with or a keen interest in learning about machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), or LLMs.
  • Interest or coursework in Responsible AI, data privacy, product policy, or adjacent safety fields.
  • Strong communication skills, a proactive attitude toward learning, and eagerness to collaborate in a global, multi-regional team environment.

title: SMB Channel Sales Manager, Google Cloud

Working closely with regional partner managers, direct sales teams and other cross functional teams. title: Staff Data Scientist, Product
descriptionHtml:
Help serve Google's worldwide user base of more than a billion people. Data Scientists provide quantitative support, market understanding and a strategic perspective to our partners throughout the organization. As a data-loving member of the team, you serve as an analytics expert for your partners, using numbers to help them make better decisions. You will weave stories with meaningful insight from data. You'll make critical recommendations for your fellow Googlers in Engineering and Product Management. You relish tallying up the numbers one minute and communicating your findings to a team leader the next.Google is an engineering company at heart. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on users around the world. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, social to local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Modular Infrastructure, Global Data Centers
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will direct the cross-functional program strategy, governance, and operational frameworks for Google’s Modular Manufacturing and Integration organization. As a founding member of this newly formed team, you will operate with high autonomy, partnering directly with leadership to help define and shape how this organization operates from the ground up.

title: Senior Product Manager, Eval Quality, AI Data
descriptionHtml:
Artificial Intelligence is evolving at an unprecedented pace, and AI Agents represent the next frontier. These agents, capable of complex reasoning, tool use, and interacting with dynamic environments, are poised to redefine how we live and work. Ensuring these agents are safe, reliable, and effective is paramount, and that's where evaluations come in.

Evaluations have always been the bedrock of successful AI development. However, the methods used for traditional Large Language Models fall short when it comes to agents. Unlike static models, agents operate in a world of vast possibilities, delivering value through a sequence of actions and interactions.

We need to pioneer new ways of thinking for agent evaluation. Think Waymo online: we must create rich, dynamic simulation environments to test agents against a massive state space, uncovering failure modes and ensuring robust performance across countless scenarios. This isn't just an incremental improvement; it's about defining how the next generation of AI will be validated.

If you're passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI and solving some of the most problems in the field, this is your chance. Come join our Evals team, where with products like Everest and EvalHub, we empower GenAI model development across Google. In this role, you will lead the product goal for how Google evaluates AI Agents, ensuring we build the most capable and trustworthy agentic systems in the world.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a first-principles understanding of what makes an evaluation task truly useful—optimizing for coverage, climbability (scaling with compute and data while preserving headroom), discriminability, statistical stability (tight confidence intervals), and zero contamination.
  • Synthesize insights into a holistic product goal and roadmap for Eval Quality.
  • Operate seamlessly across Product Area boundaries between Gemini, AI2, and other partner product areas.
  • Grow in Gemini’s dynamic, fast-moving, research-driven environment where priorities evolve rapidly and Product Managers earn trust by directly contributing to day-to-day execution.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in a product management, engineering, and technology strategy role.
  • 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with LLM/GenAI evaluations, post-training/mid-training RL/SFT workflows, autoraters, or human-in-the-loop (HiTL) expert data collection.
  • Deep intuition for evaluation science—understanding what separates a brittle benchmark from a high-signal, climbable, uncontaminated evaluation across specialized verticals (e.g., finance, law, medicine, math, science, and engineering).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the gravitas to align Executive Team Leads, Research Scientists, and VP/SVP leadership across London and US time zones.
  • Demonstrated track record of growing across Product Area boundaries specifically balancing the changing, execution culture of research organization.

title: Senior Research Scientist, Foundational AI in Health
descriptionHtml:
As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Our team generates novel health insights and builds foundation models (wearables and Electronic Health Records (EHR)) using large datasets from nationwide studies. We publish our research breakthroughs and partner cross-functionally to translate them into products that improve millions of lives. You will collaborate alongside researchers, engineers, and the Gemini team.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of foundational AI and health research. You will develop novel multi-modal model architectures, perform experiments, and apply advanced theories to build AI-native products. Partnering with product teams, you will advance foundational AI capabilities, publish research findings, and collaborate to enhance healthcare outcomes.

The Health Platforms and Devices team builds innovative products and services that help our users live longer, healthier lives. We bring together the best of Google technologies and AI, health behavior science, and user-centered design to help users organize the health and wellness data, get insight from it, and take action toward their health goals. We do this with a suite of apps, services, and health wearables. We aim to make consumer health more personal, proactive, and actionable.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct AI research and development in the field of health technology, primarily focusing on wearables and mobile platforms, for tracking and predicting health-related metrics and outcomes.
  • Design architectures for multimodal AI models and set up tests to deploy ideas broadly, while building and improving AI research infrastructure by ingesting datasets and maintaining evaluation systems.
  • Communicate research findings to a wide variety of audiences, and publish findings in academic journals.
  • Identify upcoming research areas by interacting with potential collaborators to help develop long-term research strategy and plans that expand the impact of Google research.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners on engineering, product, and clinical teams to integrate research developments into consumer-facing products.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • 2 years of experience with modern machine learning frameworks such as JAX, PyTorch, or TensorFlow and distributed training on accelerators.
  • One of more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories (such as CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience in machine learning research, foundation models (e.g. LLMs, VLMs, time-series foundation models), Generative AI, and coding experience in Python in a team-based environment.
  • Experience modeling longitudinal or multimodal real-world data such as wearable sensor data, physiological signals, health records, imaging.
  • Experience building data pipelines and experimentation systems for large, heterogeneous datasets.
  • Experience designing evaluations, metrics, and controlled ablations that produce reproducible and defensible research results.

descriptionHtml:

title: SoC and IP Design Engineer, Networking
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

In this role, you will join an IP and subsystem design team building foundational custom silicon for Google Cloud, rather than focusing solely on standalone block coding or chip-level assembly, blends Register-Transfer Level (RTL) micro-architecture with complex IP and subsystem integration. You will architect and implement custom wrappers, bridges, protocol adapters, and control, interrupt, and debug infrastructure to integrate third-party vendor IPs and internal blocks such as high-speed Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe) subsystems into cohesive, production-ready designs.

You will help modernize how we build silicon beyond RTL development, create and refine scripting and design automation flows that streamline large-scale IP assembly, configuration, and sign-off, while actively adopting and shaping advanced AI-powered and agentic workflows across hardware design, integration, and debug. You will partner closely with architecture, verification, physical implementation, Design for Test (DFT), software, and external IP vendors, you will drive Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) trade-offs from initial specification through silicon bring-up.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Define IP and subsystem micro-architecture specifications, including interface protocols, block diagrams, clocking and reset schemes, register maps, and transaction flows.
  • Integrate complex third-party vendor IPs and internal blocks (such as PCIe subsystems), developing custom SystemVerilog RTL wrappers, glue logic, and protocol adapters.
  • Execute RTL quality sign-off and debug across functional and performance simulation, Lint, Clock Domain Crossing (CDC), Reset Domain Crossing (RDC), Formal Verification, and Unified Power Format (UPF) checks.
  • Build and enhance design automation, RTL assembly tooling, and AI-assisted hardware engineering workflows to accelerate integration velocity and design quality.
  • Collaborate with architecture, verification, physical design, DFT, firmware, and external IP vendors on synthesis, timing and power (PPA) closure, coverage analysis, and ASIC silicon bring-up.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in digital logic design and RTL development using Verilog or SystemVerilog.
  • Experience with IP integration, subsystem design, or System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture.
  • Experience with logic synthesis, timing closure, and low-power design techniques.
  • Experience with RTL quality and sign-off tools (e.g., Lint, CDC).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience integrating third-party vendor IPs (such as controllers and PHYs), owning RTL wrappers, timing constraints, UPF, DFT handoffs, and vendor deliverables.
  • Experience with PCIe architecture and subsystem integration, or related interconnects and protocols such as Compute Express Link (CXL), Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe), or Advanced Extensible Interface (AXI).
  • Experience developing scripts, RTL assembly automation, and Electronic Design Automation (EDA) flows (e.g., Python, Tcl).
  • Demonstrated eagerness to adopt and pioneer AI-driven tools and workflows across hardware design, integration, and debug.

You will also be responsible for identifying and collecting data sources, building and validating models, and refining them based on feedback. title: Associate Legal Counsel, Commercial
descriptionHtml:
This Associate Legal Counsel role will provide transactional and advisory support across both EMEA Procurement & Inbound Legal and EMEA Marketing Legal. In this role, you will independently lead complex, high-value commercial negotiations, ranging from strategic inbound technology, AI, professional services, and outsourcing agreements to flagship regional sponsorships, creative/media agency deals, and brand partnerships. In addition to high-priority contracting, you will act as a trusted advisor to procurement and marketing stakeholders, delivering pragmatic risk assessments on multi-jurisdictional marketing campaigns, advertising compliance, consumer protection, IP, data privacy, and AI governance. You will also be expected to drive team-wide operational excellence across EMEA by helping to design and maintain scalable templates and playbooks, leveraging AI contracting tools, resolving complex escalations, and mentoring junior team members.

Our mission is to drive the success of Google’s business operations and brand initiatives across EMEA through principled, innovative and commercially-minded legal strategies. By combining deep commercial contracting expertise with regional insight, we enable our internal clients to move quickly and responsibly, whether sourcing critical third-party services and technologies or launching high-visibility marketing campaigns across EMEA.

Responsibilities

  • Structure, draft, and negotiate complex, high-value commercial agreements across EMEA, covering both strategic inbound procurement (software, AI technologies, professional services, and outsourced operations) and regional marketing initiatives (flagship sponsorships, agency agreements, media buying, and brand partnerships).
  • Provide pragmatic, end-to-end legal and regulatory counsel to marketing and procurement stakeholders on multi-jurisdictional brand campaigns, product launches, promotional activations, and supplier engagements across EMEA.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with a broad range of stakeholders to assess and mitigate complex risks across IP, data privacy, AI governance, consumer protection, and advertising law.
  • Handle complex contract escalations, interpretation disputes, and senior stakeholder briefings, balancing commercial velocity with sound risk management.
  • Lead scalable legal operations initiatives across EMEA, developing regional templates, fallback playbooks, and client trainings, integrating AI-powered contracting tools, and providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members as required.

Minimum qualifications:

  • JD, LL.B., equivalent degree, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of attorney-level experience in government, in-house, or at a law firm.
  • Experience leading the structuring, drafting, and negotiation of commercial or enterprise service agreements at a technology company or in a legal environment focusing on technology customers/agreements.
  • Admitted to the bar and in good standing or otherwise authorized to practice law (e.g., have registered in-house status) in the jurisdiction in which the position is located.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience providing marketing and advertising advisory support across EMEA (including consumer protection, advertising standards, promotional activations, and brand campaigns).
  • Experience in the technology, digital media, or corporate procurement sector.
  • Experience designing and delivering streamlined, efficient contracting playbooks, templates, and commercial programs.
  • Experience working on legal matters across EMEA, including UK and European digital, AI, privacy, and extended workforce regulations.
  • Experience managing multiple simultaneous projects to deadline.

title: Social Intelligence Manager, Brand Social
descriptionHtml:

You live in social conversation daily, helping us manage issues and opportunities as they arise, while driving marketing’s larger understanding of cultural shifts.

You will also lead day-to-day operations of the global, 24/7 listening program, directing agency and vendor partners. Working with internal and external partners, you will leverage AI and automation to scale our listening systems, using signals to inform long-term product roadmaps, brand marketing and daily channel automation briefs, improve listening systems and cross-functional processes through AI and automation. You will further be highly involved in Google’s brand channel programming priorities, including by inputting into the strategic direction of owned social media channels and informing content, campaign and channel briefs.

You will combine analytical excellence with strong storytelling, cultural curiosity, and operational leadership. You are fascinated by people and communities, understand how platform mechanics shape participation and distribution, and can distinguish a supported finding from an interpretation that needs further investigation.
Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can--changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Full Stack
descriptionHtml:

We are reimagining Fitbit to create an AI-first experience anchored in actionable coaching that delivers continuous, proactive guidance for fitness, sleep, and more.

Health sensing is shifting from hand-tuned heuristics to foundation models, and from reactive care after symptoms begin to proactive early detection and intervention (e.g., insulin resistance and blood pressure trends). This shift is led by research, with productionisation and quality translation driven by this role.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

  • Define and own shared launch criteria with Research, covering accuracy, latency, battery, serving cost, reliability, and privacy.
  • Build system health metrics, regression tests, and staged rollouts, plus pipelines that capture and transport raw wearable sensor data.
  • Write design docs and code, lead system design across device, mobile, and backend, and decide where computation runs.
  • Mentor engineers across sites, share new AI approaches, and align Product, UX, Research, and Clinical teams on sensing strategy.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with wearables or physiological sensing (e.g., PPG, ECG, IMU, skin temperature).
  • Experience with foundation models or large-scale machine learning on sensor or time-series data.
  • Experience designing and serving ML systems across device, mobile, and cloud, including latency, battery, and capacity planning.
  • Experience shipping health or wellness features with high standards for data quality and privacy (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA). Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction across organizations and sites.

title: Senior Category Manager, Marketing Procurement (English, Japanese)

You will pioneer innovative marketing category strategies and cultivate strategic buy-side partnerships that unlock measurable enterprise value. Leveraging deep expertise in marketing verticals, you will design long-term roadmaps, navigate decentralized networks, and advise senior executives. Crucially, you will advocate an AI-first transformation across our domain. By leading new AI approaches, you will maintain thought leadership on the impact to our supplier base and ensure robust category governance, to mitigate risk, and evolve commercial model frameworks to drive a competitive advantage for Google.

descriptionHtml:

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Our Research Scientists at DeepMind are at the forefront of advancing artificial intelligence. In this role, you will join our team focused on pushing forward fundamental research and technology in Artificial Intelligence, specifically in the domains of Memory, Reasoning, and Continual Learning. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking research and publish in venues.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. title: Senior Software Engineer, Health and Home Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a software engineer on the Health and Home Infrastructure team in Zurich, you will build and maintain the software infrastructure that powers products relied on by millions of people in their daily lives.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Help us advance the state of the art in preventive health care by predicting health risks, such as high blood pressure and insulin resistance, based on a treasure trove of fitness and medical data.
  • Bring machine learning research into our products by partnering with our research teams.
  • Build machine learning infrastructure for large-scale model training and evaluation.
  • Improve and maintain our infrastructure for smooth operation and minimal toil.
  • Build data pipelines for creating large-scale machine learning datasets of highly sensitive fitness and medical data. Drive platform unification and simplicity.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development.
  • 3 years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale Machine Learning infrastructure and distributed systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • Experience with software development in C++ or Python, with a strong background in systems programming.
  • Experience in architecting scalable machine learning pipelines, from data set management to automated model training.
  • Experience in performing deep-dive forensics on distributed systems to root-cause failures across multiple languages and frameworks.

title: Software Engineering Manager II, YouTube
descriptionHtml:
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

  • Set clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role and aligned to the broader organization's goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development and provide feedback and coaching.
  • Develop the mid-term technical vision and roadmap within the scope of your (often multiple) team(s). Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs.
  • Design, guide and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and write product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems.
  • Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

  • 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).

Preferred qualifications:

descriptionHtml:

We are helping to find, grow and keep the remarkable assemblage of talent who are our Googlers. You'll be an advocate of Google's culture and values, partnering with our business leaders to help them build their organizations and make sure all people decisions are based on data. Whether coaching our clients on how to lead their teams, navigating and resolving employee relations issues or managing programs that help develop our Googlers, you are exceptionally focused on putting them first, and being as clear and transparent as possible to help Googlers understand how people decisions get made.

You can lead change in a number of areas, including Labour relations, strategic capability, manager effectiveness, policy and process, culture and engagement and incident response. You offer a trusted voice around HR matters as it relates to the Market, internally and externally.

You will manage multiple projects and country-specific initiatives effectively and understand when and how to appropriately escalate decisions or urgent matters. You facilitate partner discussions and drive decisions that are good for Google and bring partners/stakeholders along with their change management skills. You can shift gears quickly, balancing the need to analyse/research thoughtfully and move quickly to action/incident response.

HR consultants care about Googler experience and proactively seek out opportunities to make improvements, taking ideas through to completion. You also work closely with Market delivery teams to develop subject matter/operational expertise within a variety of service areas, leveraging partner teams to increase impact and scale where required.

Great just isn't good enough for our People Operations team (known elsewhere as "Human Resources"). We bring the world's most innovative people to Google and provide the programs that help them thrive. Whether recruiting the next Googler, refining our core programs, developing talent, or simply looking for ways to inject some more fun into the lives of our Googlers, we bring a data-driven approach that is reinventing the human resources field.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering, Vertex
descriptionHtml:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is what you get when you treat operations as if it’s a software problem. Our mission is to progress, protect, and provide for the software and systems behind all of Google’s public services - Search, Ads, Gmail, Android, YouTube, and AppEngine, to name just a few - with an ever-watchful eye on their availability, latency, performance, and capacity.

This is an unusual job, unlike others in the industry. Like traditional operations groups, we keep important, revenue-critical systems up and running despite hurricanes, bandwidth outages, and configuration problems. Unlike traditional operations groups, we also have full access to and authority to fix, extend, and scale the code to keep it working and harden it against all the vagaries of the Internet. We hire people from both systems and software backgrounds. Strong candidates will have experience with both.

Just as what we do is unique, where we do it is unique too. At Google, we have the good fortune to have developed many interesting systems ranging from planet-spanning databases to near real-time scalable data warehousing to fault-tolerant datastream joining. In SRE, we flip between the fine-grained detail of disk driver I/O scheduling to the big picture of continental-level service capacity, across a range of systems and a user population measured in billions. We own those products in production. We drive reliability and performance across massive scale by mastering the full depth of the stack. We literally do learn something new every day - usually surprising things - that have the potential to transform the lives of billions of our users around the world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

  • Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews.
  • Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.
  • Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
  • Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.

title: Research Scientist, User Signals from Agentic Logs, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
As a part of the Gemini User Signals team, a Research Scientist will help drive the post-training strategy of our most advanced models, dedicated to establishing the "flywheel" of alignment, converting complex user interactions and feedback into training signals that fundamentally improve model behavior. In this role, you will lead research into reward modeling, preference optimization, and data-centric strategies to close the loop between user deployment and model training. You will help define the horizontal recipes that allow us to scale these insights across different modalities and model families.Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. Responsibilities

  • Develop and refine reward models and critique models that accurately capture user intent and satisfaction, serving as the foundation for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and other alignment techniques.
  • Create and validate "horizontal" post-training recipes that can be robustly applied across different model sizes and modalities (including text and audio).
  • Investigate novel methods for weighting, synthesizing, and selecting data to maximize the impact of user signals on model performance.
  • Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks to measure the correlation between offline metrics (reward model accuracy) and online user satisfaction.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with modern alignment and post-training methods (e.g., RLHF, DPO, PPO, rejection sampling, or self-play).

  • Experience training or evaluating reward models, critique models, or automated evaluators (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge).

title: Research Engineer, Chemical, Biological and Nuclear AI Safety, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
Google’s CBRNE team (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear and Explosives) in Responsible Frontier AI Research makes sure that as Gemini gets better at science, it does not become a tool for catastrophic harm. We are a team of engineers working alongside biologists, chemists, and physicists. (Deep expertise in one field is plenty; nobody on the team covers all of them.) This is a research engineering role: you will do applied research, write production code, and launch the resulting safeguards to billions of users.

This role is probably not for you if you want to publish most of what you do, or if you are looking for a policy or purely research position. Expect strict data managing, tight release timelines, and an on-call rotation. You will read and debate technical material about mass-casualty harm and how to prevent it. You will dig into the small discrepancies that hint at big problems. One week you might design new safeguards; the next, find out why an evaluation result looked too good to be true, or attack our safeguards before someone else does.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

  • Architect the reliability of key systems, including safeguards and incident response.
  • Partner with leading scientific experts to turn their judgment into datasets and automated graders, managing sensitive data under strict security controls.
  • Communicate results, including uncertainty and negative findings, to technical staff and leadership.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor degree or equivalent practical experience in a management, scientific, technical or engineering field.
  • 8 years of experience writing code in a shared, version-controlled codebase with other contributors, which may include research software.
  • 3 years of experience training, fine-tuning or evaluating machine learning models.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience building classifiers or evaluation infrastructure for large language models.
  • Experience applying statistics to machine learning evaluation.
  • Experience running software in production, including monitoring, on-call or incident response.
  • Experience in chemical, biological, radiological or nuclear security, export control, or adversarial work such as red teaming, security research or abuse prevention.

title: Advanced Packaging Development Engineer, Quantum AI
descriptionHtml:
In the device packaging group, we build custom packaging technologies for quantum processors, amplifiers, and other electronic devices that operate from DC to microwave frequencies in a cryogenic environment. Our work includes research on quantum processor performance and qubit environment, test articles, and hardening of current technologies for deployment. Every Google Quantum AI processor comes through our lab for packaging before its deployment to the fleet.

As an Advanced Packaging Engineer, you will focus on emerging packaging technologies essential for the scaling of superconducting quantum processors and associated components. You will pioneer innovative packaging methods such as 2.5D/3D integration and novel interconnect technologies. You will collaborate closely with the quantum processor team and RF engineers. Your goal will be to transition research concepts into deployable packaging solutions that enable the scaling roadmap of our quantum processors and quantum computing systems.

The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large-scale computer capable of complex, error-corrected computations. Google Quantum AI's mission is to build this computer and unlock solutions to classically intractable problems. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Principal Engineer, Safeguards
descriptionHtml:
Within the Cloud AI organization, we focus on building highly differentiated, highly scalable, and easy-to-use products and services that enable our customers to transform their business with AI. Products such as Vertex AI and Gemini Enterprise comprise a portfolio that spans the needs of Developers, Data Scientists, Operation specialists in a broad range of industries. We not only provide customers with state-of-the-art models, such as Gemini, but also full Agent platforms and applications with strong security and governance.

The Principal Engineer, Cloud AI Safeguards is a senior individual contributor and the technical authority for safety and security across the Cloud AI product portfolio, with a primary focus on agentic safety. Reporting to the Senior Director of Cloud AI Safeguards Engineering, this role sets technical direction without managing people: defining architecture, raising the engineering bar, and personally designing and building defenses that meaningfully reduce risk as model capabilities, product surfaces, and adversaries evolve. Agentic systems make the safety problem substantially harder — autonomous tool use, long-horizon planning, and untrusted inputs expand the attack surface — and this role exists to get ahead of that complexity rather than react to it.

The ideal applicant looks deeply into hard problems, approaches them with curiosity and objectivity, works across teams and individuals to recommend solutions, and makes complexity legible by explaining it clearly and designing it away.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design, prototype, and ship safety for AI driven threats across CBRN, Cyber, Agentic, Fraud risks with classifiers, runtime policy enforcement, and ML systems. Own the technical vision and reference architecture for safeguarding agentic systems across tool use, planning, memory, and multi-agent interactions, etc.
  • Lead threat modeling for increasingly complex attack surfaces, anticipating adversary behavior and translating it into concrete engineering requirements and defenses.
  • Shape the shared safety and security infrastructure that AI workloads depend on, ensuring defenses are reusable across products.
  • Work objectively across teams and team members to diagnose problems, recommend solutions, align on standards, and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentorship, etc.
  • Build data analysis, detection, and response capabilities needed to observe safety-relevant behavior at scale, measure efficacy, and close the loop quickly when threats emerge.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15 years of professional experience in engineering leadership or related technical roles.
  • Experience in AI and machine learning, including building and deploying classifiers and ML systems in production.
